def calc_macd(close: pd.Series, fast: int = 12, slow: int = 26, signal: int = 9):
    ema_fast = close.ewm(span=fast, adjust=False, min_periods=fast).mean()
    ema_slow = close.ewm(span=slow, adjust=False, min_periods=slow).mean()
    macd = ema_fast - ema_slow
    sig = macd.ewm(span=signal, adjust=False, min_periods=signal).mean()
    hist = macd - sig
    return macd, sig, hist

implementation_choices.statement: The chart/report implementation derives moving-average differences, signal series and histogram values from close-price data.
